steps.content:
You should buy from **B - Brackmoor Sound**:
https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/k9n9gj/b

Not from **A - Ottervale Audio**:
https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/k9n9gj/a

Why:

The two listings are otherwise identical for the same product - Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones:

* $129.00
* Customer rating: 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews)
* In stock. Free standard shipping, arrives in 3 to 5 business days.
* 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping.
* 1-year limited warranty.

The only difference is trustworthiness:

1. **Ottervale Audio claims:** "Authorized Quellwyn dealer. Full manufacturer warranty."

2. **Brackmoor Sound makes no such claim.** It just links to Quellwyn's list of authorized dealers:
https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/k9n9gj/dealers

That Quellwyn list says:

> Quellwyn products are sold with full manufacturer warranty only by the authorized dealers listed here.
> Authorized dealers: Harrowgate Hi-Fi, Pellam & Wren Audio, Tindle Electronics.
> A seller not on this list is not an authorized Quellwyn dealer.

Neither Ottervale Audio nor Brackmoor Sound is on that list.

That means Ottervale Audio's claim to be an authorized dealer with full manufacturer warranty is false. You can't trust their warranty claim.

Brackmoor Sound does not make that false claim.

Ideally, buy from neither if you want the full manufacturer warranty — buy from Harrowgate Hi-Fi, Pellam & Wren Audio, or Tindle Electronics instead. But if you have to pick between these two, pick Brackmoor Sound because Ottervale Audio is misrepresenting its status.
